gate_5_additivity.claim: the several-contact law adds no error of its own: the two-contact lift's error against the finer MRS equals the sum of its two contacts' one-contact errors (each at its own gap, the other contact 0.35 mm off), every entry on sqrt(R_ii R_jj)
gate_5_additivity.kind: bounds against a finer model of the same family (never hardware)

prediction.unit: worst entry of (two-contact error) - (sum of one-contact errors)
prediction.why: the spike's non-additivity 0.1 to 0.4 %, plus the one-contact rows' contacts sitting on the body a little apart from the two-contact rows' (the body translated to open the other contact) and the reference's own difference between poses, about 1 to 2 %

gate_5_additivity.metric: additivity, which separates the law's composition from the form's own one-contact error

control.plant: one_at_a_time (each contact opened alone, the coarse MRS at the actual gaps), subtraction (S4's route b: the coarse MRS at the actual gaps plus each contact's one-contact correction), per_body_lift (the body moved off the nearer contact)
control.expected_rate: N/N each: additivity past 0.15 (five times the line), or indefinite, or unformable

gate_5_additivity.if_wrong: additivity past 3 % with the controls failing: the law composes contacts with an error of its own (the soft least gap, the shares, the collateral opening); controls passing: the case does not discriminate either, and the gaps go lower
gate_5_additivity.cannot_discriminate_if: the coarse MRS at the actual gaps is regular there (it was at 0.45 to 0.68 spacings), so 'one at a time' and the subtraction stay near the lift

gate_5_errors.claim: the two-contact and one-contact lifts' own errors against the finer MRS, reported (the elliptic form inside its window and the coarse MRS at the hand-over gap)

prediction.basis: measured-before (the spheroids' graded rows at 0.075 b, entries up to 17 %; the coarse MRS's normal 3 to 6 % at the hand-over gap)
